reconciledTip: Atlas checks every figure against OKX: balances and positions every minute, fees, funding and transfers every 5 minutes.
staleTip: OKX hasn’t answered for a few minutes. Atlas keeps retrying every minute; figures may be out of date.
chartLabel: Equity over {{range}}, from {{from}} to {{to}}. Use the arrow keys to read values.
pctNeedsBaseline: Atlas shows a percentage once it has a starting equity above zero to measure from.

empty.title: No data yet
empty.body: Atlas is syncing your OKX demo account. The first sync takes about a minute; figures appear here as soon as OKX answers.

error.title: Couldn’t load your portfolio
error.body: Atlas’s server didn’t answer. Check that Atlas is running with ./atlas up, then try again.
